compiled_state.title: As an agent operator, the merge workflow detects merge conflicts and dispatches /dso:resolve-conflicts before CI remediation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add mergeStateStatus CONFLICTING detection to _phase_remediate; dispatch /dso:resolve-conflicts when conflicts are detected; re-check mergeStateStatus after resolution; emit CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_FAILED escalation if conflicts remain.

**Why**: Merge conflicts block all CI checks from running. Satisfies SC2 — the remediation loop must resolve conflicts before it can remediate CI failures.

**Scope**:
- IN: mergeStateStatus CONFLICTING detection via gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus; /dso:resolve-conflicts dispatch; post-resolution mergeStateStatus re-check; CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_FAILED escalation path (exits to user, no retry); conflict phase runs before CI tier processing
- OUT: Bounding counters for other stop_reasons (→S4); global ceiling interaction semantics (→S4); state file persistence of conflict phase (→S4)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a PR with mergeStateStatus=CONFLICTING triggers /dso:resolve-conflicts dispatch before any CI failure remediation begins
  ← Satisfies: "SC2: The remediation loop detects merge conflict PR status and dispatches /dso:resolve-conflicts before re-triggering CI checks"
- When this story is complete, after /dso:resolve-conflicts returns, mergeStateStatus is re-checked; if conflicts remain, the loop exits with ESCALATION_REASON: 'Conflict resolution failed' without retrying
  ← Satisfies: "SC2: If conflict resolution fails, the loop emits ESCALATION_REASON: Conflict resolution failed and exits to user escalation without retrying"
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for mergeStateStatus detection logic and conflict escalation path

## Considerations

- [Reliability] /dso:resolve-conflicts may resolve some conflicts but not all — explicitly re-check mergeStateStatus after resolution before declaring success or failure
- [Testing] Mock gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus response to test CONFLICTING detection without live GitHub connection
- [Reliability] Coordinate with S4 on whether conflict-resolution attempts consume a slot in the global ceiling of 15 or are counted separately. Document the chosen semantics here so S4 implements counters consistently. (Recommendation: conflict-resolution does not consume a tier attempt slot since it's a prerequisite gate, not a remediation attempt)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
